changes: No substantive changes; notes expanded slightly (Anantanāgarāja excluded as a mythical nāga king, the 'Caryutiyā' reading is uncertain)

notes: Bendall quotes no scribal colophon or date. He assigns the manuscript to the 18th century with a query, on the evidence of the script alone. The excerpts are only the subscriptions of the stotras. The Lokanātha stotra is attributed to Anantanāgarāja, a mythical nāga king, so he is not listed as a person. One stavatotra is attributed to 'चर्युतिया'. Bendall marks this reading (?), so it is probably corrupt and may not be a personal name at all. It is kept as an author with low confidence.
